Additionally, the debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 1.76 (46,596M total liabilities / 25,838M equity) suggests high leverage, while an EBIT margin of approximately 9.3% (979M / 10,496M revenue) shows modest profitability that may be insufficient to mitigate liquidity risks. Despite substantial retained earnings, the poor liquidly position elevates default risk, placing the issuer in the 'B' category where adverse conditions could impair debt-servicing capacity.

DECISION: B
